mainEntity.name: How do contractors add plumbing for a guest suite bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing placement relies on your home's existing drain, waste, and supply lines, as well as the proximity to the main sewer or septic line. During planning, a contractor evaluates whether to cut into a concrete slab or access lines through a crawlspace to extend pipes for the new shower, sink, and toilet. Tying into an existing bathroom or laundry wall on the opposite side of the new suite significantly reduces plumbing installation costs. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms inspects your existing infrastructure during the initial consultation to determine the most cost-effective plumbing routing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contractors inspect your main water and sewer lines, tying into adjacent plumbing walls or trenching through concrete slabs to supply water and drainage for the new bath.
